_comment: Human-APPROVED list of producers/retailers documented to source from a known GMO supplier (Monsanto/Bayer-type agreements). The app reads this file (https://matsjekk.com/data/ngt_suppliers.json) once per day and shows a YELLOW 'MULIG RISIKO' signal ONLY for brands listed here. Approved entries reach the app without a new release. The monitor (scripts/ngt_monitor.py) only proposes candidates; a human promotes verified ones into this 'suppliers' array.

_schema.brand_aliases: list of lowercase brand substrings matched against the product brand
_schema.reason_nb: Norwegian 'MULIG RISIKO' wording (precautionary, with a verifiable basis)
_schema.source_url: public, verifiable source documenting the GMO-supplier link

_example_disabled.reason_nb: MULIG RISIKO: Dokumentert leveranse fra kjent GMO-leverandør (Bayer/Monsanto). Se kilde.
_example_disabled.reason_en: POSSIBLE RISK: Documented sourcing from a known GMO supplier (Bayer/Monsanto). See source.
